objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the system that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving lifecycle stages. Represents policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other document types.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The user-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The document type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: A cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type assigned automatically upon creation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document, incremented upon revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which the document is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable time period for validity checks, default is 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion, default is 10 years.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: The person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to translate released content into another language.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications associated with the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational entities to which the document applies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: distribution_by_email
attributes.description: User groups or persons informed by email notification upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: User groups or persons required to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A classification category for documents that defines their level in the document hierarchy and associated properties such as templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document type (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of the document type in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The type abbreviation used in document naming conventions.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: The default period of extended validity defined for this document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: The default archive duration defined for this document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the document template.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The file format of the template (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document's release. Creation, modification, or archiving triggers a new version of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment, subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the attachment within the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle. Released and published directly via switches in properties.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or title of the additional information object.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is currently published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by any user with author rights to suggest changes to an existing document, without affecting the document's content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The content describing the proposed change.

attributes.name: processing_notes
attributes.description: Documentation of how the change proposal was handled by the document author.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiry date, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document's validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation and revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, which can only be created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current processing status of the reactivation request.

attributes.name: selected_document
attributes.description: The invalidated document selected for reactivation.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning read or change authorizations to documents, used for reader groups, author groups, reviewer groups, releaser groups, and archive groups.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the user group (e.g., Reader - Document Management, Archive).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system role associated with the group (e.g., READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups and persons who are automatically informed about releases, either by email notification or by acknowledgement requirement.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A record of a user's active confirmation of having taken note of a released document version, triggered through the distribution for acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

attributes.name: confirmed_by
attributes.description: The person who confirmed the acknowledgement.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which acknowledgement was confirmed.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task during the release process.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the signature was recorded.

attributes.name: workflow_step
attributes.description: The workflow step for which the signature was provided (e.g., Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational entity in a multi-client system where documents can be made visible or restricted.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the client.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or modified through the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving, and the current version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author completes the Creator workflow step by providing an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review workflow step, confirming or rejecting the document after checking technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the review was positive (approved) or negative (rejected).

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release workflow step, confirming or rejecting the final approval of the document.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Whether the release was positive (approved) or negative (rejected).

evts.name: reject_during_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejected_by_role
attributes.description: The role of the person who rejected (reviewer or releaser).

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The document is officially released and automatically published, becoming visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal scheduled).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A new additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document's version.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A user with author rights creates a change proposal for an existing document.

evts.name: notify_author_of_change_proposal
evts.description: The author of the underlying document is informed by email about a newly created change proposal.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the processing of the change proposal, and the creator of the proposal receives an email notification.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expiry date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is extended through the workflow-supported validity extension process, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted either after validity is extended or after a new version is released.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a released document.

evts.name: complete_override
evts.description: The override process is completed, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: complete_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation is confirmed, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups assigned to the distribution by email list are informed by email notification upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups assigned to the distribution for acknowledgement list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version through a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content is translated into another language by an assigned translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released through a workflow-supported approval process, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language of the released translation.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a specific document type that determines its level, abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type for use when creating new documents.
An attachment is a controlled document attached to a main document and released with it.
An additional information object is a supplement attached to a main document outside its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and is displayed within that document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is to be checked.
A request for override is created for a specific released document to invalidate it.
A request for reactivation references the specific invalidated document selected for reactivation.
A distribution list is maintained per document specifying who is informed upon release.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list to receive notifications or acknowledgement requests.
User groups are assigned to documents to control read authorizations via the Reader attribute.
In a multi-client system, each document specifies in which clients it is visible.
Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute.
An acknowledgement record is associated with a specific released document version.
Electronic signatures are documented per released version of a document.
